THE NATIONAL THOROUGHFARES ACT, No. 40 OF 2008

REGULATIONS made by the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development under Section 89 (2) (c) of the Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008 read with Sections 13 and 14 of the aforesaid Act.

KABIR HASHIM, Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development. Battaramulla,08th November, 2019. REGULATIONS (1) These Regulations may be cited as the National Thoroughfares (User Fee National Highway) Regulations (2) These regulations shall apply to -

The Barawakumbuka – Mattala User fee National Highway (Section of Extension of Southern Expressway) and Andarawewa – Hambantota User Fee National Highway declared by Order made under Section 11 of the National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008 published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. Gazette No. to be inserted once this has been declared as a National Highway)

(3) (1) There shall be levied from a driver of every vehicle being used on the aforesaid User Fee National Highways, a fee in respect of the use of the User Fee National Highway by such driver, at such rates speciﬁ ed in Part A of the Schedule to these regulations.

(2) The fee shall be charged in respect of the whole distance, or part thereof, of the User Fee National Highway.
(3) A single rate shall be applied for all categories of vehicles speciﬁ ed in Part A of the schedule to these regulations.

(4) (1) A driver of every vehicle who enters a User Fee National Highway from an interchange shall, prior to being permitted to proceed along such highway, obtain a ticket from the Teller on duty, at such interchange.

(2) The driver of a vehicle which has been proceeding along the User Fee National Highway, when arriving at the gate of an interchange for the purpose of exiting such User Fee National Highway shall surrender to the Teller the ticket obtained at the interchange through which he entered.

(3) The Teller shall inform the driver of the amount of the fee payable and accordingly the driver shall pay such amount, prior to being permitted to pass through such interchange, and the teller shall issue a receipt in respect of such payment.

(5) (1) A driver of every vehicle shall keep the ticket referred to in regulation 4 (1), securely in his possession until he reaches the toll gate of the interchange through which he intends to exit such User Fee National Highway.

(2) Where the driver is unable to surrender the ticket to the Teller, and the Teller fails to identify the entry location, the driver shall be deemed to have travelled the entire distance of the User Fee National Highway from the furthest possible point of entry to the actual point of exit and shall accordingly be charged a fee at the rates speciﬁ ed in Part A of the schedule to these regulations.

(6) (1) The Road Development Authority, established under the Road Development Authority Act, No. 73 of 1981, (hereinafter referred to as “the Authority”) shall ensure that, for the purpose of implementation of the provisions of these regulations, sufﬁ cient number of gates by taking into account the average Trafﬁ c volume at exit and entry points are positioned at the required places along the User Fee National Highways.
(2) The gates so positioned along the User Fee National Highway shall be owned, operated and maintained by the Authority, and each gate shall be manned by a Teller.

(3) The Teller shall be responsible for the collection of the user fee at every gate referred to in paragraph (2), in such sum as is speciﬁ ed in Part A of the Schedule to these regulations from every driver using such User Fee National Highways :

Provided that the provisions of these regulations shall not apply to a driver who is driving a vehicle of a category speciﬁ ed in Part B of the Schedule to these regulations, which is exempt from such payment.

(7) The Teller shall at such times as are speciﬁ ed, hand over the day’s collection of the fees to the ofﬁ cer authorized in that behalf by the Authority and obtain a receipt in respect of such amount.

(8) The money so collected as user fee shall be credited to the Fund of the Authority and be used for the purpose of developing and maintaining the User Fee National Highways to which these regulations apply.
(9) For the purpose of these regulations-
“Teller” means an ofﬁ cer who is manning the gates at an interchange;

“User Fee National Highways” includes Barawakumbuka – Mattala User Fee National Highway (Section of Extension of Southern Expressway) from Barawakumbuka (178.656 km) to Mattala (200.451 km) and Andarawewa – Hambantota User Fee National Highway from Andarawewa (0.000km) to Hambantota (16.558km).

(10) The driver of a vehicle who contravenes the provisions of these regulations shall commit an offence and shall on conviction after summary trial by a Magistrate be liable in the case of- (a) a ﬁ rst offence; to a ﬁ ne not exceeding ﬁ ve thousand rupees; and
(b) a second or subsequent offence; to a ﬁ ne not exceeding ﬁ fty thousand rupees.
